relationships.subject: oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: In OxPt-treated DRGs, while CD31 immunostaining was preserved around axons, IQGAP1 was absent in endothelial membranes, contrasting with its presence in controls

relationships.subject: cilastatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Importantly, cilastatin partially restored IQGAP1 expression in endothelial cells, indicating a potential endothelial-protective effect of cilastatin that could contribute to maintaining blood-nerve barrier integrity.

relationships.subject: IQGAP1
relationships.evidence_quote: Merges portray a heterogeneous fashion of co-expression, mainly in the cytosol.

key_findings: Cilastatin attenuated oxaliplatin-induced cold allodynia in rats and normalized IQGAP1 and DPEP1 patterns with reduced TNFalpha/IL-6 co-expression in DRG.
Oxaliplatin upregulated glial IQGAP1 and removed it from endothelial membranes, which cilastatin partly restored.
